import sys

def solve():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    s = next(it)
    a = [[0]*n for _ in range(3)]
    na = [0, 0, 0]
    for i, ch in enumerate(s):
        if ch == 'V':
            a[0][na[0]] = i
            na[0] += 1
        elif ch == 'K':
            a[1][na[1]] = i
            na[1] += 1
        else:
            a[2][na[2]] = i
            na[2] += 1

    # d[i][j][k][q] where q=0 last placed V, q=1 last placed not V
    d = [[[[10**9]*2 for _ in range(na[2]+1)] for _ in range(na[1]+1)] for _ in range(na[0]+1)]
    d[0][0][0][1] = 0

    # p[x][y][i] = number of y's before the i-th x in original order
    p = [[[0]*n for _ in range(3)] for _ in range(3)]
    for x in range(3):
        for y in range(3):
            if x != y:
                for i in range(na[x]):
                    cnt = 0
                    for j in range(na[y]):
                        if a[y][j] < a[x][i]:
                            cnt += 1
                    p[x][y][i] = cnt

    for i in range(na[0]+1):
        for j in range(na[1]+1):
            for k in range(na[2]+1):
                for q in range(2):
                    cur = d[i][j][k][q]
                    if cur == 10**9:
                        continue
                    if i < na[0]:
                        cost = cur + max(p[0][1][i] - j, 0) + max(p[0][2][i] - k, 0)
                        if cost < d[i+1][j][k][0]:
                            d[i+1][j][k][0] = cost
                    if j < na[1] and q == 1:
                        cost = cur + max(p[1][0][j] - i, 0) + max(p[1][2][j] - k, 0)
                        if cost < d[i][j+1][k][1]:
                            d[i][j+1][k][1] = cost
                    if k < na[2]:
                        cost = cur + max(p[2][0][k] - i, 0) + max(p[2][1][k] - j, 0)
                        if cost < d[i][j][k+1][1]:
                            d[i][j][k+1][1] = cost

    ans = min(d[na[0]][na[1]][na[2]][0], d[na[0]][na[1]][na[2]][1])
    sys.stdout.write(str(ans) + '\n')

if __name__ == '__main__':
    solve()
